panels.title: Routing distribution (last 24h)
panels.description: Share of pipeline invocations by routing arm. 'rule' is the default path; 'agent' fires only when DegradationConfig.agentic_path_enabled=True AND the AB router's agent_path_v1 experiment is enabled. 'fallback' is the degraded path triggered by an error in either arm. 'unknown' means the pipeline raised before route_decision ran (timeout / Python exception).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT arm AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM agent_runs WHERE ts > (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 86400) * 1000 GROUP BY arm
targets.queryText: SELECT arm AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM agent_runs WHERE ts > (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 86400) * 1000 GROUP BY arm

panels.title: Fallback rate (1h bucket)
panels.description: Fraction of queries that hit the fallback path, bucketed by hour. A spike here means the rule arm OR the agent arm started failing for a large fraction of traffic — investigate the underlying error in the trace table.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT datetime(ts/1000, 'unixepoch') AS time, AVG(used_fallback) AS fallback_rate FROM agent_runs WHERE ts > (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 86400) * 1000 GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', datetime(ts/1000,'unixepoch')) ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT datetime(ts/1000, 'unixepoch') AS time, AVG(used_fallback) AS fallback_rate FROM agent_runs WHERE ts > (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 86400) * 1000 GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', datetime(ts/1000,'unixepoch')) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Per-stage latency (last 24h, mean + max)
panels.description: Mean and max duration per pipeline stage. SQLite has no native percentile function; this v1 ships mean + max instead of p50 + p95 (runbook B5 acceptance allows this fallback). The next iteration can compute true percentiles via a window-function rewrite (PERCENTILE_CONT is in SQLite 3.45+) or via a two-pass query.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT stage, AVG(duration_ms) AS mean_ms, MAX(duration_ms) AS max_ms, COUNT(*) AS n FROM agent_stages WHERE query_id IN (SELECT query_id FROM agent_runs WHERE ts > (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 86400) * 1000) GROUP BY stage ORDER BY mean_ms DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT stage, AVG(duration_ms) AS mean_ms, MAX(duration_ms) AS max_ms, COUNT(*) AS n FROM agent_stages WHERE query_id IN (SELECT query_id FROM agent_runs WHERE ts > (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 86400) * 1000) GROUP BY stage ORDER BY mean_ms DESC

panels.title: Agent tool calls by name (last 24h)
panels.description: Tool-call counts split by ok vs error status. A tool with high error_count is a candidate for prompt-strengthening or argument-validation work.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT tool_name, SUM(ok) AS ok_count, SUM(1 - ok) AS error_count, COUNT(*) AS total FROM agent_tool_calls WHERE query_id IN (SELECT query_id FROM agent_runs WHERE ts > (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 86400) * 1000) GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY total DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT tool_name, SUM(ok) AS ok_count, SUM(1 - ok) AS error_count, COUNT(*) AS total FROM agent_tool_calls WHERE query_id IN (SELECT query_id FROM agent_runs WHERE ts > (CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER) - 86400) * 1000) GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY total DESC
